messages:
sara_ops: Peregrine Logistics is seeing persistent 502s from our Dedicated eu-west-1 pool since ~09:22 UTC. Their routing service is failing for a subset of account keys. Paging oncall @mike_oncall — marking SEV=2 for now.
incident-bot: Incident created: REDWOOD-INC-2012345678 | severity: 2 | owners: mike_oncall, james_sre | runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-502s 
statusbot: Auto-check: 12/50 hosts reporting 502s, 3 hosts flapping. Health aggregator -> degraded.
mike_oncall: Acknowledged. I’m on it. Starting log tail on the pool and checking load balancer health. Can someone paste affected account IDs?
ryan_se: Pasted in #help: peregrine-acct-01, peregrine-acct-09, peregrine-acct-11. Seeing elevated backend latency from their client traces.
alice_cse: I’m drafting a short customer-facing blurb for Peregrine Logistics. Draft below — please edit: 
```
We are investigating elevated errors impacting routing requests for Peregrine Logistics in eu-west-1. Our engineering team is actively mitigating; we will provide updates every 15 minutes. No data loss is expected.
```
sara_ops: +1 to send ASAP once we confirm scope. Putting them on targeted status page component 'dedicated-eu-west-1-routing'.
mike_oncall: Found a spike of 503->502 conversion in the ingress proxy logs; upstreams reporting 'connection reset by peer' to the model pool. Rolling a targeted restart of 4/12 replicas in the pool to drain connections.
incident-bot: Action: rolling-restart initiated on pool ded-eu-42 by mike_oncall. ETA ~3m.
james_sre: If restarts don't clear, be ready to fail traffic to the burst-capacity tier and route to a fallback model variant (low-latency -> stable-quantized). Preparing the routing override now.
mike_oncall: Restart complete on 4 nodes. Error rate dropped 30% in metrics, but two accounts still getting 502s. Continuing investigate.
ryan_se: I can see their trace spans timing out at LB->ingress at ~5s. Might be a connection reuse bug under heavy keepalive. Adding a temporary keepalive timeout clamp on the ingress proxy (30s -> 10s) as a mitigation.
alice_cse: Customer blurb updated with timeline and workaround. Suggested status page entry below (copy/paste):
```
Status: Partial degradation - eu-west-1 Dedicated routing
Impact: Some Peregrine Logistics requests may receive 502 errors or experience retries.
Scope: Affected account keys: peregrine-acct-01, -09, -11.
Mitigation: We are rolling restarts and applying an ingress keepalive clamp. Traffic may be routed to a fallback variant where needed.
ETA: Next update in 15 minutes.
```
statusbot: Status page updated for component dedicated-eu-west-1-routing by alice_cse.
sara_ops: Action items: (1) mike continue mitigation, (2) james prep and stand by for routing override, (3) alice coordinate customer comms and send tailored email once stabilised.
mike_oncall: Handing off to james_sre for overnight monitoring — I need a few hours offline. Summary for handoff: restarted 4/12 replicas, applied temporary keepalive clamp on ingress, error rate down 30% but two account keys still impacted, routing override ready but not yet flipped. Metrics + runbook link attached above.
james_sre: Taking over. Will keep polling every 5m and escalate if >10% error rate persists across accounts. If we flip routing override, notify support and update status with exact timestamp + fallback variant.
alice_cse: Preparing customer email now. Draft: 
```
Subject: Incident: Peregrine Logistics - routing errors in eu-west-1
Body: Hi team, we are investigating intermittent 502s affecting routing for some requests. Engineering applied mitigations and we will follow up within 15 minutes with status. No customer data was exposed.
```
sara_ops: :thumbsup: Good. Once james confirms stable for 30m, coordinate formal post-incident follow-up with affected account contacts and run a short RCA.
incident-bot: Incident REDWOOD-INC-2012345678 | status: under investigation -> mitigation applied | severity: 2 | owners: james_sre 
statusbot: Next auto-update scheduled in 15 minutes.
